Hi all! We'd like to announce Software Verification in Lean 2026, a one-day open workshop taking place in Paris on the 20th of April, organised by BAIF and LeanFRO.

The workshop brings together researchers and practitioners working on formal verification of software using Lean. The programme covers recent advances, practical techniques, and ongoing challenges in building verified software. We welcome anyone working in or around proof engineering, programming language theory, or software development.

You'll find the full details, including the programme and speaker information, on the conference website: Software Verification in Lean 2026

Attendance is open to all (but registration is mandatory!). Please note that room capacity is very limited. Talks will be streamed, and more details will appear on the website in due time. Please share this with colleagues or communities who might be interested.

We look forward to seeing you in Paris on April 20th.

Best,
Ashley Blacquiere (LeanFRO)
Oliver Butterley (BAIF)
Alessandro D'Angelo (BAIF)

Following the success of our Paris workshop in April, we’re pleased to announce Software Verification in Lean, Fall 2026, a one-day open workshop taking place in Palo Alto on the 7th of November, co-organised by BAIF and Lean FRO.

The workshop brings together researchers and practitioners working on formal verification of software using Lean. The programme covers recent advances, practical techniques, and ongoing challenges in building verified software. We welcome anyone working in or around proof engineering, programming language theory, or software development.

You’ll find the full details, including the programme and speaker information, on the workshop website: Software Verification in Lean, Fall 2026.

Attendance is open to all (but in-person registration is mandatory!). Please note that room capacity is very limited. Talks will be streamed, and more details will appear on the website in due time. Please share this with colleagues or communities who might be interested.

We look forward to seeing you in Palo Alto on November 7th.

Best,
@Lennart Beringer (BAIF)
@Ashley Blacquiere (Lean FRO)
@Oliver Butterley (BAIF)
@Matej Penciak (BAIF)
